newsitem.title: MEXICO: Citibank, Argentaria bid for Mexico's Confia.
newsitem.headline: Citibank, Argentaria bid for Mexico's Confia.

text.p: Citicorp's Citibank and Spain's Argentaria have put in bids for Mexican bank Banca Confia, and the decision should be made soon, Mexico's top banking official said on Wednesday.

"Citibank and Banco Argentaria have already made their offers to the investment bank SBC Warburg, who is helping us evaluate them," Eduardo Fernandez, head of the National Banking and Securities Commission, told reporters.
He said the proposals were being studied by Jorge Lankenau and the other main shareholders of Grupo Financiero Abaco, which counts Confia as its main subsidiary.
"In the next few weeks we'll have a definite decision," Fernandez said.
Like other Mexican banks, Confia has faced a pressing need to raise capital after the 1995-6 banking crisis. ((--Cecilia Cardenas, Redaccion Mexico 728-9552))
